root_cause.text: A reference leak occurs in the `amdgpu_userq_wait_ioctl` function because the code fails to release the `dma_fence` reference via `dma_fence_put` when aborting the ioctl due to insufficient output array capacity.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `dma_fence_put(fence);` statements immediately before the `goto free_fences;` label in two error paths triggered by `WARN_ON_ONCE(num_fences >= wait_info->num_fences)` checks in `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_userq_fence.c`.

intent_record.how: Releases the reference held by the fence iterator when the fence count exceeds the expected limit, preventing a reference count leak before jumping to cleanup.
